title: Mental Health Impacts of AI Companions: Triangulating Social Media Quasi-Experiments, User Perspectives, and Relational Theory
reasoning: The paper focuses on the psychosocial and mental health impacts of AI companion chatbots (AICCs). While it contains a dedicated section on ethical and privacy implications (Section 6.3), this is a reflection on the research's findings and methodology rather than a core component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
